t: Vim Macro to Lua (for NeoVim Users)
s: This article details the challenges of refining Vim macros and demonstrates how to convert them into more manageable Lua functions for NeoVim, leveraging AI assistance for modernization and preservation of muscle memory.
sub: Refining Vim macros and their inherent editability issues.
The history and pain of text editor churn and macro phantom limbs.
Converting VimScript macros to Lua for NeoVim, enabled by AI.
Using AI (Claude via Cursor) for macro conversion and iterative refinement.
